propositions: Bridge is hardcoded to one tracker project at three independent points: scalar JiraConfig.project, JQL pair construction in fetcher, and single-project guard in applier, blocking teams that need multiple projects against one codebase.

Solution models many-to-many as one shared ticket store owning a project mapping (projects.json) between N repos and N tracker projects, with each ticket recording its source project and repo association.

Ticket project field is tri-state: absent means legacy (default from store mapping), explicit-empty means never sync, explicit key means sync to that project; migration writes no events, using ensure unit seed and legacy default resolution.

Multi-project inbound fetch iterates configured project set for base JQL and three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results into shared snapshot with per-query truncation scoped per project.

Single-project stores remain writable by older binaries; multi-project stores require multi-project-bridge capability stamp in .store-compat.json and fail closed on binaries lacking it, preventing cross-project ticket contamination.
Store-compat capability and project mapping mutation land in same atomic tracker commit via bridge projects set/remove write path, with ensure units as convergence backstops for residual divergence.
